what: DMA.KVWB_DS throughput + exactness of the DMA mover's KV write-back engine (ot_hgi_dma_mover KVW=1 VR2=1 -> ot_hgi_dma_kvw)

bench.shape: production: the mover on the REAL loader kport (ND 5, NO 16, RB 64, NQ 4, WNO 16) + four behavioural svc stacks (ot_hbm_svc_core_native + refresh-aware PHY, XLAT 76,000 ps ~ RTT 160 cyc, svc write pop stalls 1/8), VM DMA wide read group model (GLAT 12); KVWB = 512 FP32 VM words -> one 2,048 B HBM ring row, issued as ot_hgi_dma_record POSTED issues them (next move on mv_rdy after mv_src)
bench.gate: KVB_MAX 63.0 cyc: first (isolated) record accept -> mv_src, and the per-layer-ring (rotating stack) burst's posted cycles/record

kvw_on.note_1stack: back-to-back on ONE stack the 512-sector buffer fills after 8 records and the rate becomes the stack's write rate (svc kport write credits WNO 16 over the ack loop: 17.5 B/cycle/stack in this bench) -- a svc/kport limit, not the mover; the token issues one KVWB a layer

results.kvw_mut5: MOVER-KPORT FAIL (the second drain port takes the head's hold entry): mutant detected

bottleneck_removed: sector engine: 1 sector/cycle landing + unpack, one VM sector in flight a read lane (VR2) or 4 outstanding (packet client, the die view), write-lane request register re-armed from its own valid (1 write / 2 cycles a lane), mover busy until the last write ack -> KVW: 2 sectors/cycle issue (2 in flight a lane), 2-port in-order drain into a 2-bank 512-slot buffer, posted retire on buffer write, 4 per-stack write streams (2 bank reads/cycle), ping-pong registered lane requests (1 write/cycle a lane), next move accepted while writes drain
integration: opt-in KVW=0 default; needs VR2=1 (the VM DMA wide read group). The die view physical/hbm_accel_die_views/loader_hgi_dma instantiates ot_hfd_loader_hgi with VR2 0 (the vr2 group is not wired at die level) and the e2e tb_hgi_e2e uses VR2 0: the KVWB rate in the die/e2e needs the die-integration lead to wire dma_vr2q/dma_vr2r and set VR2=1 KVW=1.
